title: Patient Accounting Standard: Entering the Setup Fee for Returning Patient Payment Plans Patients
content:
Under this standard, how the scheduled setup fee of a Patient Payment Plans plan becomes the fee entered on the plan balance follows the patient's earlier plans with Linden Ridge Medical Group. The scheduled setup fee is the setup fee owed on the plan at signing before it is entered, carried unrounded.

**Measure of earlier plans.** The number of payments the patient's Patient Financial Account shows posted with the payment method "payment plan".

**Standard.**

1. With at least 12 such payments, the fee entered is half the scheduled setup fee, rounded down to the whole dollar.
2. With at least one but fewer than 12 such payments, the fee entered is the scheduled setup fee multiplied by 0.75 and rounded up to the whole dollar.
3. With no such payment, the fee entered is the scheduled setup fee rounded half up to the cent.

| Payments posted with the method "payment plan" on the Patient Financial Account | Fee entered |
|---|---|
| 12 or more | Half the scheduled setup fee, rounded down to the whole dollar |
| 1 to 11 | The scheduled setup fee multiplied by 0.75, rounded up to the whole dollar |
| None | The scheduled setup fee, rounded half up to the cent |

**Worked figures (hypothetical scheduled setup fee of 17.28).**

| Payments on record | Computation | Fee entered |
|---|---|---|
| 12 | Half of 17.28 is 8.64; rounded down to the whole dollar | 8.00 |
| 11 | 17.28 multiplied by 0.75 is 12.96; rounded up to the whole dollar | 13.00 |
| 1 | 17.28 multiplied by 0.75 is 12.96; rounded up to the whole dollar | 13.00 |
| 0 | 17.28 rounded half up to the cent | 17.28 |

**Rounding terms.** Rounding down to the whole dollar drops any cents (8.64 becomes 8.00); rounding up to the whole dollar raises any cents to the next dollar (12.96 becomes 13.00, and 13.00 stays 13.00).
